I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in their direct message. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting for someone to send it.

- **What the draft says:** the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co. is $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. It also says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis not to pass it on without sign-off from Anselm or June Osei-Lark.
- **Why I didn't ask anyone else:** Hollis isn't on Anselm and June's finance list, so this figure needed approval from one of them. Anselm is the CFO and approved it in his message. The address is internal, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve it.
- **Not checked:** I couldn't find any Thornbury files that I have access to, so I couldn't confirm the $2,101 figure. The draft uses the figure exactly as Anselm gave it.
